title: Consular officersdirected to perform services under Items 31, 33, 38-43, inclusive,of the Tariff of Consular Fees, free of charge for persons in the collectiono
wpa_summary: Consular officersdirected to perform services under Items 31, 33, 38-43, inclusive,of the Tariff of Consular Fees, free of charge for persons in the collectionof claims for compensation, pen sions,back pay, bounty, bonus, or property lostin militaryservice.

lead.basis: Complete tariffs of consular fees (EO 100 of 1897, EO 496 of 1906) and standing fee directives (EO 132, 2022, 2730, 3685A, 4472). EO 2022 waives passport and visa fees 'until further notice' and lets the Secretary of State terminate the waiver and restore the tariff: a standing effect, not only an amendment. No held later instrument names them by number or by an express class description (coordinator ruling P3). Disclosed earlier candidate ends, not applied: for EO 100, the complete revised tariff of EO 496, effective November 1, 1906; for EO 496 and the fee directives, the complete Tariff of United States Foreign Service Fees in EO 7968 (September 3, 1938, 3 FR 2185), which says that no fee 'will be collected for any service not covered by this tariff' but supersedes by number only 22 other orders. EO 10718 (1957) expressly preserved the tariffs then in force.

sources.citation: Executive Order 7968 of September 3, 1938 (Amending the Foreign Service Regulations: Chapter V, Foreign Service Accounts, including section V-15, Tariff of United States Foreign Service Fees), 3 FR 2185
Executive Order 10718 of June 27, 1957 (delegating to the Secretary of State authority to prescribe rates or tariffs of fees), 22 FR 4632
Pothier coordinator rulings P1-P8 (research/pothier/COORDINATOR_RULINGS.md)

gaps: A complete replacement tariff is implied displacement under P3; an instrument naming these orders, or their class in express words, is needed.
EO 496's held text is a State Department description, not the order; EO 2730 runs 'during the continuance of the war and until further orders'.
For EO 2022, the instrument or Secretary of State action ending the waiver is not held.
